description: Greater Visakhapatnam Municipal Corporation (GVMC) runs one unified grievance mechanism across all civic complaint types, with four channels: (1) a toll-free IVRS call centre, 1800-4250-0009, staffed 6:00 AM-8:00 PM -- dialling 1 records a complaint (name, address, phone) after the beep, issues a complaint number, SMS-notifies the concerned official with full details, SMS-confirms the complaint number to the citizen, and SMS-confirms again once the complaint is marked redressed; (2) PGRS (Public Grievance Redressal System), an in-person walk-in session every Monday 11:00 AM-1:00 PM at GVMC's premises; (3) an Online Grievance Redressal System (web); (4) the Smart Vizag mobile app. The same IVRS number also handles related requests when dialling 2 (water tanker request -- transferred to a call-centre operator who logs details, generates a code, and informs the filling station) and 3/4 (tax and general prerequisite information, e.g. for a new water connection, title transfer, birth/death certificate).
procedure: Call the toll-free IVRS number 1800-4250-0009 (6:00 AM-8:00 PM) and press 1 to record a complaint (name, address, phone number) after the beep -- a complaint number is issued and confirmed by SMS, with an SMS notification also sent to the responsible official. Alternatively, attend the weekly in-person PGRS session (every Monday, 11:00 AM-1:00 PM, at GVMC's premises), use the Online Grievance Redressal System, or the Smart Vizag mobile app.
